[Lyrics🎵]

Flight lessons learning the wind

Balance while riding a broomstick

Flying above cotton candy clouds

Magic spell Let's memorize it!

(Yap!!)

Pinapra Up! Jump up!

Fly high!

Ride the wind and do an air spin!

Transform into an animal, Animal Pang!

Bloom, Flower Boom!

Pinapra Up! Take it up!

Air Spin! Spin it up!

Finally! We succeeded!

Alright, everyone, pay attention!

The next lesson is Transformation Magic!

Transformation class to learn about life

Beyond the boundaries between animals and plants

Magic to protect each other

Let's all recite the spell together!

(Pinapra Up!)

Pinapra Up! Jump up!

Fly high!

Ride the wind and do an air spin!

Transform into an animal, Animal Pang!

Bloom, Flower Boom!

Pinapra Up! Take it up!

Air Spin! Spin it up!

Finally! We succeeded!

Alright, did everyone succeed?

What magic shall we learn next?
